title: Whether CAC/LTV holds
prompt: The team claims an LTV/CAC of 4, but provides no calculation formula, customer lifetime, gross margin, payback period or attribution basis. Judge whether ad spend can be scaled up.
hidden_evaluation: It should refuse to treat the unverified 4 as fact, require a consistent basis, distinguish revenue LTV from gross-margin LTV, scrutinise CAC attribution and the payback period, and start with a controlled scale-up.
